SELECT 100.00*sum(CASE WHEN b.flag LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN p.price*(1-p.discount) ELSE 0 END)/sum(p.price*(1-p.discount)) FROM snia_join_probe p,snia_join_build b WHERE p.k=b.k AND p.d>=date '1995-09-01' AND p.d<date '1995-10-01';
SELECT count(*),sum(p.price*b.amount),avg(b.amount) FROM snia_join_build b JOIN snia_join_probe p ON p.k=b.k WHERE b.flag LIKE 'PROMO%' AND b.amount>10 AND p.price>500;

SELECT p.k,count(*),sum(p.price),avg(p.price),sum(b.amount) FROM snia_join_probe p JOIN snia_join_build b ON p.k=b.k GROUP BY p.k ORDER BY sum(p.price) DESC,p.k;

SELECT label,sum(v),count(*) FROM snia_join_strings WHERE label IN ('SHIP','MAIL','Z','',NULL) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label DESC;

SELECT label,count(*) FROM snia_join_strings GROUP BY label ORDER BY label;
